findings.description: Release-launch check fails: campaign22 (easy), campaign23 (hard) and campaign24 (chaos) were launched with -Dachievetodo.progression.freshConfig=true in addition to the two -javaagent flags. The brief requires no -Dachievetodo.* flags. The value is not in the plugin's derived list (output.log line 207: derived=[bacap.directory, bridge.server, progression.world, progression.worldKey]), so the operator supplied it by hand. All thresholds-easy/hard/chaos rows therefore come from a launch that is not the certified operator launch. campaign21 and campaign25 are clean.
The ATD_STAGE2A_STATE ability field is {"SHOOT_CROSSBOW": null}, so the lock snapshot is not visible. The denial is shown only by the DENIAL_INTENT line.
